versions.changelog:
idea-capture v1.0.0

- Initial release for automatic user idea capture.
- Monitors all conversations; silently writes potential ideas, requests, or pain points to inbox.md without confirmation.
- Supports configurable review schedules (daily/weekly) and multiple review destinations (Feishu, Notion, local file).
- Does not notify users upon capture; operates fully in the background.
- Configuration summary is presented at activation for user confirmation and customization.
